name: tilted-card
title: Tilted Card
author: AlgorizeTech
description: A card that tilts in 3D toward the pointer with a moving glare highlight. Use it to make a single feature or product card feel tactile.
docs: Named export: TiltedCard. Wraps arbitrary children; tune `tiltIntensity`, `glareOpacity` and `scaleOnHover`. Pointer-driven, so it is inert on touch — keep the content readable without the effect.
